arguments.text: Let the pack go, settle into your own steady pace.

text: let_go: holding the wash takes 202 W shaft against 152 W critical power and 162 W sustainable; the pod reserve would empty in about 1100 m of 5800 m left.

arguments.text: Let them go now. Ease to your own steady pace.

arguments.message: shaft power well above critical power while pod reserve is draining

text: no cue: let_go cue blocked by cooldown (a cue went out 50 s ago); added a watch to wake me if shaft power stays above 185 W.

arguments.text: Ease a little. Settle at 2:42 pace and hold it.

text: ease: off the wash, shaft 181 W against 158 W sustainable; pod reserve 41% would empty in 880 m of 4750 m left.

arguments.text: Ease off. Current is against you, settle at 2:55 pace.

text: ease: shaft 186 W against 157 W sustainable, pod reserve 31% empties in 560 m; current now against (-0.12 m/s), so the display target moves to 2:55.

arguments.text: A touch easier still. Hold 2:58 pace into the current.

text: ease: shaft 167 W still above 155 W sustainable with pod reserve at 17% and 4180 m left; most of the fade is the lost wash, so ease rather than change rate.

arguments.text: Reserve is spent. Ease to 3:01 pace, long and smooth.

text: ease: pod reserve is empty with 3500 m left and shaft 165 W above the 152 W critical power; dropping just under it avoids a blow-up and rebuilds a little for the sprint.

arguments.reason: Held about 163-168 W shaft (105-110 W boat) for 10 minutes with both reserves reading empty and no blow-up; the steady fade of about 6-7 percent is mostly the wash lost after minute 3, not growing fatigue.

text: no cue: the paddler has held about 164 W with steady speed for 10 minutes past an empty reserve, so the test was low; raised critical power to 162 W shaft and leave the pace alone.
no cue: effort steady near 165 W with speed through the water holding at 3.0 m/s and a stable fade; 2250 m left is too far for the sprint.

arguments.text: Lengthen out, drop two strokes a minute, same pressure.

text: rate_down: fade grew to 9% at an unchanged rate of 63 while shaft power rose to 171 W, a sign of tiring; a lower rate should recover speed for the same effort.

arguments.reason: Shaft power collapsed from about 160 W to a flat 116 W for 70 s after long spells above 162 W with an empty reserve: a blow-up, so 162 W was too high.

text: no cue: shaft power has collapsed to a flat 116 W, a blow-up that a push would only prolong; let it recover and save the reserve it rebuilds for the final sprint.

arguments.text: Too early. Ease a touch, sprint from 200 to go.

arguments.message: about 230 m to go: time to call the finish sprint if the pod reserve allows

text: ease: 187 W with 8% pod reserve empties in 140 m of 518 m left, so a blow-up before the line; hold back and sprint from about 200 m.

arguments.text: Go now! Sprint everything to the line.

text: finish: 233 m left with 17% pod reserve, enough for about 195 W to the line, so spend it all now.
no cue: the finishing sprint is on and the pod reserve empties right at the line.
